items.title: Ambarella warns memory scarcity is cutting customer outlooks
items.summary: Ambarella reported record edge AI revenue but warned that memory scarcity and prices are causing customers to reduce forecasts. Next-quarter revenue guidance suggests a substantial sequential decline. The premarket selloff reflects a documented operating headwind rather than sentiment alone.

observations.label: Nov 24 fiscal Q3 report
observations.value: Revenue $115.2M, +6.2% YoY; GAAP gross margin 57.8%; GAAP net loss $12.7M.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Memory prices, supply availability, customer forecasts and order recovery.

items.key_finding: Memory shortages are now causing documented demand pressure downstream in edge AI.

items.title: Dell sells off despite record quarterly results and raised guidance
items.summary: Dell more than doubled quarterly revenue and significantly raised its annual outlook. Shares traded lower before the open despite the strong results. Backlog conversion, financing and memory costs remain important risks.

observations.label: Q3 FY27
observations.value: Revenue $54.9B, +103% YoY; adjusted EPS $9.45; operating cash flow $4.5B.

observations.label: AI backlog and guidance
observations.value: Approximately $132B AI backlog; FY27 revenue guide $202B.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Order conversion, customer financing, cancellations, margins and cash generation.

items.key_finding: Strong reported hardware fundamentals diverge from negative market sentiment; valuation and execution risks remain.

items.title: Nutanix succession and broader software weakness extend tech selloff
items.summary: Nutanix fell sharply in premarket trading after announcing a CEO succession search, despite recurring revenue growth. Autodesk and Workday also fell after raising annual outlooks. The moves suggest broader risk aversion alongside company-specific uncertainty.

observations.label: Nov 25 7:45 AM EST premarket
observations.value: NTNX -13.9%, ADSK -5.0%, WDAY -4.7%, QQQ -2.9%; not closing figures.

observations.label: Nutanix Q1 results
observations.value: ARR $2.63B, +15% YoY; revenue $772.4M, +15%; CEO remains until successor takes role.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Succession progress, subscription growth, guidance and regular-session breadth.

items.key_finding: Selling pressure extends into enterprise software despite positive reported operating trends.

items.title: Oil rises on unverified Ras Tanura refinery attack claim
items.summary: Reuters reported oil prices rising after Houthis claimed an attack on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery. Physical damage and lost production remain unverified. UKMTO separately split a previously reported Hormuz incident into three notices rather than three additional attacks.

observations.label: Physical flow status
observations.value: Ras Tanura attack claim not independently verified; no new measured production loss.

observations.label: UKMTO
observations.value: 219-26, 220-26 and 221-26 represent reclassification of previously reported incidents.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Official refinery operating status, tanker loadings, EIA inventories and insurance.

items.key_finding: Oil risk premium rises without verified additional physical supply loss.

items.title: Asian chip-heavy equity markets close sharply lower as relief rally fades
items.summary: South Korea erased Tuesday's recovery and Taiwan suffered broad losses as semiconductor selling intensified. Japan also declined while Australia gained. Foreign selling and reported prospective U.S. tariffs compound AI valuation concerns, but the market action does not establish declining semiconductor orders.

observations.label: November 25 local-market closing changes, independently corroborated
observations.value: KOSPI -6.16% to 4,697.51 (MoneyToday and Seoul Market Wire); TAIEX -4.80% to 38,195.43 (CNA and Financial Express); Nikkei -2.78% (SquawkNews and AP, rounded -2.8%).

observations.label: Taiwan breadth and foreign flows, CNA
observations.value: 39 advancers, 1,053 decliners; foreign institutions net sold NT$123.65 billion.

observations.label: Fundamentals and next indicators
observations.value: Price stress reflects AI valuation, trade and liquidity risks, not demonstrated chip-order deterioration. Watch foreign flows, breadth, company order revisions, tariffs, PCE and Treasury yields. Sustained broad recovery would weaken stress signal.

items.key_finding: Asian closing figures confirm the semiconductor-led reversal spread beyond early Tokyo trading.

sources.title: Seoul Market Wire: Korea close and foreign flows
Focus Taiwan: foreign selling and chip moves
